record.question: India's first Water Metro, an integrated water-transport project was launched in:
record.explanation: Answer C: Kochi. Kochi is the location of India’s first Water Metro project. Kerala’s State Planning Board records that the project was sanctioned in November 2015, and Kochi Metro Rail Limited records that the tripartite agreement was executed in June 2016—before this 2019 paper. “Launched” can refer to the project, not passenger service, which started later; option (c), zero-based index 2. Reference: https://spb.kerala.gov.in/economic-review/ER2017/web_e/ch51.php?ch=51&id=50; https://kochimetro.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/KMRL_AR_2016-17_EN_HIN.pdf; https://watermetro.co.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
